description: Use this when you need a signed snapshot to store or show (valid three hours); it is not a prediction. What the ledger measured about one registration at its last evaluation under agent.pass.v2, valid three hours: published level L7+, no open harm-kind incident, a counted payment in the last 30 days, its newest payment in character, no issuer freeze on a bound wallet, no unlimited approval to a plain key, no harm-kind incident in 90 days, and a month without a payment out of character. Answers holds or not, which checks failed, which could not be taken (listed, never written as 0), when it was checked and when it expires, with the issuer's public key. Every Pass that holds is signed with Ed25519 (since 24 Oct 2026); since 7 Nov 2026 the same Pass is also served as a JWT and as a W3C Verifiable Credential (JWT encoding, issuer did:web:agenticfinancegraph.com) at /api/pass?agent=<id>&format=jwt or &format=vc, for systems that verify offline. A Pass says what was checked and when; it never says safe, verified or trusted, and says nothing about the next three hours.
